title: James-type constants for Birkhoff--James orthogonality and approximate isosceles
summary: We introduce two James-type constants associated with approximate isosceles and approximate Birkhoff--James orthogonality in real normed spaces. The isosceles family coincides with the classical James constant of Gao and Lau [J. Austral. Math. Soc. Ser. A 48 (1990), 101--112], while the Birkhoff family extends the orthogonal James constant of Baronti and Papini [Constr. Math. Anal. 5 (2022), no.~1, 37--45].
